description:
Brand Introduction

NUDUS was founded with the mission to redefine undergarment comfort. Inspired by the Latin word "nudus," meaning "naked," the brand focuses on creating undergarments that feel natural and effortless. By sourcing ultra-soft, lightweight materials such as rayon made from bamboo and soft cotton, NUDUS offers a second-skin fit that liberates you from discomfort, helping you feel confident, free, and authentically yourself.

Product Description

NUDUS undergarments are crafted from premium natural fibers, including bamboo rayon and soft cotton, which are incredibly gentle on the skin. These materials are designed for breathability and moisture-wicking, ensuring all-day comfort without compromising on quality or aesthetics.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

NUDUS stands out for its unparalleled combination of natural comfort and premium style. People say that it is the best "Bang for one's buck" underwear in the market. This focus on liberation and effortless comfort sets NUDUS apart, making it the go-to choice for individuals seeking stylish undergarments that don’t compromise on comfort and are really affordable.

Payment Terms

For Affiliates:

  • Commission Structure: Affiliates earn 12%–15% commission on each sale through their unique affiliate link.
  • Payout Threshold: Minimum $25 in approved commissions for payout.
  • Payment Schedule: Payments are processed monthly till the 15th.
  • Payment Methods: Affiliates can choose between PayPal or direct bank transfer.
  • Cookie Tracking: Affiliates benefit from 30-day cookie tracking, ensuring commissions on delayed purchases.

Other Information

  • Affiliate Perks: Access to free marketing tools, branded assets, and exclusive rewards for top performers.
  • Earning Potential: Affiliates can earn between $2,592–$16,200 annually depending on performance, with opportunities for bonuses on sales exceeding $3,000 per month.
  • Promotion Tips: Focus on social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, targeting a fashion-forward audience aged 25–45. Use Nudus’ approved materials to ensure brand consistency and compliance.
  • Compliance: Affiliates must adhere to all program guidelines, including ethical promotion and proper use of brand assets.

For more details, visit the Nudus Affiliate Portal or contact support at support@nudusunderwear.com.

NUDUS AFFILIATE PROGRAM TERMS & CONDITIONS

By joining the Nudus Affiliate Program, you agree to the following Terms and Conditions. These terms are designed to ensure a mutually beneficial relationship between you (the affiliate) and Nudus Underwear (the company). Please review them carefully before signing up.

1. Affiliate Eligibility

  • Affiliates must be 18 years or older to participate.
  • Affiliates must have an active and authentic online presence, including blogs, websites, social media platforms or have some sort of community/audience.
  • Nudus reserves the right to approve or reject any application at its sole discretion. Accounts that promote content in violation of our brand values (e.g., explicit, hateful, or unlawful content) will not be accepted.

2. Affiliate Responsibilities

  • Affiliates must comply with all applicable laws and regulations when promoting Nudus products.
  • Affiliates are responsible for using only approved marketing materials (provided by Nudus) and must not misrepresent the brand or products in any way.
  • Affiliates are prohibited from bidding on branded keywords (e.g., "Nudus Underwear") in paid search campaigns without prior written consent.
  • Affiliates must not use spam, unsolicited email marketing, or any deceptive tactics to promote Nudus products.

3. Commission Structure

  • Affiliates earn a 12% to 15% commission on all referred purchases made through their unique affiliate link.
  • Commissions will only be paid on completed sales. Returns, chargebacks, and cancellations will not qualify for commission.
  • Cookie tracking lasts 30 days from the customer’s initial click on your affiliate link. Purchases made after this period will not qualify for commission.

4. Payments

  • Payouts are made monthly, provided the affiliate has met the minimum payout threshold of $25.
  • Actions are locked 60 day(s) after end of the month they are tracked
    Approved transactions are paid 15 day(s) after end of the month they lock.
  • Payments are made via PayPal or direct bank transfer. Affiliates are responsible for ensuring their payment details are accurate and up to date.
  • Commissions earned will be reviewed and approved before payout. Any fraudulent or suspicious activity may result in the forfeiture of commissions.

5. Intellectual Property

  • Nudus grants affiliates a limited, non-exclusive license to use approved brand assets (e.g., logos, banners, product images) solely for the purpose of promoting the Nudus Affiliate Program.
  • Affiliates may not alter, modify, or create derivative works of Nudus’ intellectual property without prior written permission.
  • All rights to Nudus trademarks, logos, and other intellectual property remain with the company.

6. Termination

  • Either party may terminate this agreement at any time by providing written notice.
  • Nudus reserves the right to terminate an affiliate’s account immediately in cases of non-compliance with these terms, fraudulent behavior, or harm to the brand’s reputation.
  • Upon termination, affiliates must immediately cease the use of all Nudus branding and promotional materials.

7. Limitation of Liability

  • Nudus is not responsible for any losses, damages, or liabilities resulting from the affiliate’s participation in the program.
  • Affiliates participate at their own risk and are responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable legal requirements.

8. Program Modifications

  • Nudus reserves the right to modify these Terms & Conditions, the commission structure, or any aspect of the affiliate program at any time. Affiliates will be notified of changes via email or the affiliate dashboard.
  • Continued participation in the program following such changes constitutes the affiliate’s acceptance of the updated terms.

9. Confidentiality

  • Affiliates must keep all information about the Nudus Affiliate Program confidential, including performance data, payouts, and any proprietary company information.

By signing up for the Nudus Affiliate Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions.
